name: Washington: Washington State Residential Code (chapter 51-51 WAC)

review.note: Adopts IRC 2021 (Washington State Building Code Council; Chapter 51-51 WAC). State amendments to the checked rules: openable area, share of floor area. Amendments were researched for stairs, ceiling height, light and ventilation only; every other rule (room size, egress, escape openings, electrical, alarms) is the base code's. rules.note: Washington deletes the 4% openable-area requirement and requires whole-house and local exhaust mechanical ventilation instead (WAC 51-51-0303).
